_comment: Inputs the canonical data does not define. Fill only with art director / GDD decisions; null = unknown (the pipeline then skips rigging for walkers and keeps generator units for props). limbCount: 0, 2, 4, or "auto" = accept the mesh's own measurement only when it is unambiguous (2 or 4 feet, high confidence; otherwise the rig is refused with the measurement in the report). files.<stem> overrides one file and wins over species.<id>.

<file stem, e.g. zephyr_Adult_v2>._landmarks: optional JSON (path relative to this file) with manual points: headTip, headCenter, neckBase, chest, pelvis, tailBase, tailTip, feet{Fore_L..}, appendages, eyes
